payload.claim: `PhaseName` (used as the type of `PhaseStart.phase`) lists `"SCOPE"`, `"PLAN"` and `"SALVAGE"` as phases and omits DIAGNOSE and GATE, while its own docstring at line 91 calls this set 'the eight phases'. CONTEXT.md §Phase is explicit that phases are DIAGNOSE, IMPLEMENT, GATE ⇄ REPAIR, REVIEW, REBUT, PACKAGE, and separately states the plan checkpoint is 'Deliberately *not* a phase' with an explicit instruction to avoid the token 'PLAN' for it. A type named `PhaseName` that admits `"PLAN"` as a member, and a docstring that asserts it covers 'the eight phases', restates as code exactly the conflation CONTEXT.md exists to prevent, and SA-0040/SA-0030 will inherit this mislabeling when they build the renderer and mapping table on top of it.
